explanation: date_trunc moves both days to the first of their month, and date_diff then counts the calendar months between them: January to March is 2, February to February is 0 and December to January is 1. Dividing the days by 30 would give 0 for all three, because 31 January to 1 March is only 29 days; counting whole months would give 1 for the first user; and month numbers without the year would make December to January -11.
